compliance.status: in compliance via adopted HEFSP; RDP=0 / VLA applied; all prospective need addressed as unmet need

notes: DCA obligation: present_need=6, prospective_need=295. HEFSP confirms: present_need=6, prospective_need=295, RDP=0 (Vacant Land Adjustment applied), full 295 addressed as unmet need. Rehabilitation: 6-unit program via Edgewater Housing Authority. Round 4 Fourth Round compliance sites: 1339 River Road (inclusionary, 5 aff units), 8 Somerset Lane (100% affordable senior), 435-439 Undercliff Ave (market-to-affordable condos, 11 units), Quanta 145+225 River Road (large inclusionary 259 aff), and AH-2 District (105 total/16 aff). Round 3 carryover sites also listed (615 River Rd, 575 River Rd, 180 Old River Rd, 163/135 Old River Rd, MB Edgewater, 1000 Portside Drive) — those are prior-round completions not counted toward Round 4. Candidate snapshot error: 615 River Road listed 200 affordable units; HEFSP says 180 affordable units.
